    The Function Layer offers API function for either writing to a register or reading from a register.

  • About this document
  • Setting up the MOTIX™ TLE9186QV device driver
  • In detail: MOTIX™ TLE9186QV device driver
  • Modules
    • Shadow Registers

      The Shadow Register holds a copy of the internal registers of the TLE9186.

    • Register Information

      The addresses, masks and bit-positions are necessary to access each an every bit of the TLE9186 device.

    • Initialization Values

      The initialization values are needed for the initialization of the register shadow and are based on the reset value of each register.

    • Types

      The device driver uses AUTOSAR datatypes which need to be defined. This file offers the possibility of either using the platform datatypes or custom data types.

    • Function Layer

      The Function Layer offers API function for either writing to a register or reading from a register.

    • Register Layer

      The Register Layer offers API function for either writing to a register or reading from a register.

    • Service Layer

      The Service Layer is in charge of generating correct MOSI frames based on the information received from the Register Layer. While doing so it calculates the CRC checksum.

    • Application Layer

      The Application Layer is in charge of utilizing the API functions of the device driver to an application code.

    • Hardware Abstraction Layer

      The Hardware Abstraction Layer offers platform depended functionality to the device driver. These functions are used by the Service Layer and the Application Layer.

  • Data Structures
  • Disclaimer

Function Layer

The Function Layer offers API function for either writing to a register or reading from a register.

It additionally provides API functions to clear status bits on the device.

The Application Layer uses these API function during initialization and its cyclic task. A user is able to utilize these function for every specific task.

void TLE9186_FuncLayer_get_BD_STAT ( void )

get function for register BD_STAT.

This function reads the register HS & LS Gate Drivers monitoring .

uint16 TLE9186_FuncLayer_get_BD_STAT_DSOV_HS1 ( void )

Get function for BD_STAT_DSOV_HS1.

This function returns the value of the bitfield Drain-source overvoltage monitoring of HS1 within register BD_STAT.

Returns
Value of the bitfield BD_STAT_DSOV_HS1:

  • 0: BD_STAT_DSOV_HS1_CONST_0 (no drain-source over-voltage detected).

  • 1: BD_STAT_DSOV_HS1_CONST_1 (drain-source over-voltage detected).

This function sets the bitfield PFB1 counter update indication in register PHASE1_CNT.

Parameters
u16_value
Value to be written into PHASE1_CNT_PFB1_CNT_UPD. Valid values are:

  • 0: PFB1_H_CNT_PFB1_CNT_UPD_CONST_0 (PFB1 counter has not been updated at least once since the last SPI read-out).

  • 1: PFB1_H_CNT_PFB1_CNT_UPD_CONST_1 (PFB1 counter has been updated at least once since the last SPI read-out).

Returns
Status if request was added to queue. Valid values are:

  • 0: Request was not added to queue.

  • 1: Request was added to queue.
